depthTiers.label: The Verge
depthTiers.summary: The track margin. Passing traffic keeps the thorn cut back, so the growth here is young and the things in it are small.

depthTiers.label: The Route
depthTiers.summary: The thorn wall the terrace track runs beside. A1 4.2's binding band for the zone — it describes this skirting passage, not the ground behind it.

depthTiers.label: The Interior
depthTiers.summary: The bramble body, off the track and out of sight of it. No road has ever crossed here and nothing cuts the thorn back.

depthTiers.label: The Heart
depthTiers.summary: The roadless centre, and the deepest root mass in the zone. The oldest growth holds the most water, which is why the largest things stand here.
